summary: Warsh's first Jackson Hole speech as Fed Chair is today's defining event, with markets starved for clarity on whether 3.7% inflation will force the first rate hike since 2023. Equities drifted flat on the week as Nvidia's earnings pop faded, bonds rallied on Treasury buyback support, and gold held its outperformance bid against a softening dollar.
tweet: Warsh at Jackson Hole today with a 34% hike probability hanging over markets — stocks flat, bonds bid, crypto surging as traders await the Fed's clearest signal yet.
